findings.observation: These pages contain only a centered underlined lecture number plus running header and folio, leaving almost the entire page empty. Each is immediately followed by a full lecture opening with title, author and text or contents. This produces two successive openings for XV, XVI, XVII and XVIII.
findings.evidence: All four visible in contact sheets; 120,154,177 also viewed individually.
findings.recommendation: Coordinator should decide whether to suppress these additional divider pages to follow the original book opening more closely. No changes made during this review.

findings.observation: Across all 100 thumbnails, body columns, headers and folios appear consistently placed. No obvious cut-off text, clipped formulas, diagram spill outside the page, or overlapping blocks was observed at contact-sheet scale. Wide diagrams on pages130,131,181,187 and191 appear contained.
findings.limitation: Thumbnail inspection cannot establish individual symbol correctness, tiny spacing quality, or full formula readability.

findings.observation: The Chinese lecture labels, running headers and folios are legible and have no visibly missing or substituted glyphs in these three individual renders.
findings.limitation: These samples are nearly blank lecture dividers. No substantive Chinese paragraph, equation or detailed diagram was available in these three high-* renders, so no high-resolution body/formula legibility claim is made.

limitations: This is a layout/legibility review, not translation proofreading or mathematical verification.
